scope: Single-machine observational samples. Headed Chrome on Apple metal-3. Unrelated compiler jobs and a busy Chrome renderer were observed; total navigation timings are not isolated speedup estimates or cold-driver guarantees. Our browser experiments were sequential. GPU elapsed ranges include overlap/waits, not exclusive busy time.

analysis.scope: Partitioning plus all 85 resource closures. Fresh sources, alternating warm Node process; exact output/binding equivalence.

discardedExperiments.decision: Keep bounded async preparation at eight; larger batches did not improve Studio and synchronous compute-pipeline creation was slower.
